regions.finding: Four substrate rows were visually read. Each row contains a Pd-catalyzed coupling/cyclization to an E/Z macrocycle 3 and a separate downstream hydrogenation to macrocycle 4. The eight stage records preserve row-specific substrate labels, E/Z ratios, 12 h coupling times, isolated yields, CHCl3 additive equivalents, EtOAc/MeOH ratio, and isolated hydrogenation yields.
